# Beyond Beauty Salon (بيوند بيوتي صالون)

> Hair, bridal and nails salon in Egypt founded by hairstylist Ahmed Batekha. Three branches: Sheikh Zayed (The Lane Mall, Palm Hills), Zamalek (9 El Gezira El Wosta St., Cairo) and Sahel (North Coast, summer). Appointments are booked directly on the website.

## Branches
- Sheikh Zayed: The Lane Mall, Palm Hills, Sheikh Zayed City, Giza. Phone 0114 225 0001.
- Zamalek: 9 El Gezira El Wosta Street, Zamalek, Cairo. Phone 0103 738 3913.
- Sahel: North Coast, open in summer. Phone 0103 766 6725.

## Services
- Styling: blow-dry, Hollywood waves, curtain bangs, event styling
- Colour: balayage, highlights, blonde refresh, root colour
- Cuts: haircut and blow-dry, restyle, fringe trim
- Up-dos and bridal: up-dos, half-up, bridal consultation, bridal trial, veil placement
- Treatments: repair, smoothing, gloss
- Nails: gel sets, gel manicure, manicure, pedicure

## Booking
- Book online at /#book: choose branch, services, stylist, date and time. Instant booking reference, no app or deposit.
